rationale: C06 is the closest in form and phrasing, opening with the President joining an anniversary recognition and then praising the relevant public-serving group. But this is generic ceremonial-letter language rather than a distinctive, material drafting template. C22 similarly concerns a fitting national observance, while C13 shares the substantive themes of reserve forces, citizen participation, and national defense. Neither supplies a sufficiently parallel structure or concrete language for the child's brief commendatory message.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am delighted to join with the Reserve Officers Association and patriotic Americans everywhere in the observance of National Defense Week.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am happy to join with you in the recognition of the 70th Anniversary of the establishment of the Federal Civil Service merit system.
shared_material.explanation: C06 has the strongest verbal parallel, but the formula of joining an organization in recognizing an observance is conventional ceremonial correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A more fitting period for such purpose could hardly be chosen
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The importance of aviation to our nation and to the world makes it particularly fitting that the fiftieth Anniversary of this epochal event be observed in an appropriate manner.
shared_material.explanation: C22 shares the language of an observance being particularly fitting, but the remainder is an administrative direction to plan an anniversary rather than a parallel commendatory message.

shared_material.child_excerpt: National security is everybody's job today
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Every citizen is urged to do his utmost in aiding the development of effective reserve components of our armed forces
shared_material.explanation: C13 expresses the same citizen-reserve-defense concept, but does so through an executive order with materially different language and machinery.
